findings.current: “That’s only for those slowpokes! At this old man’s pace, it won’t take even a month!”
findings.defect: The draft changes 달포, approximately a month and a half, to one month, materially altering the stated travel time.
findings.rationale: 달포 denotes roughly fifteen days beyond a month, not a single month.
findings.replacement: “That’s only for those slowpokes! At this old man’s pace, it won’t even take a month and a half!”
findings.source: 그거야 느려 터진 놈들 이야기지! 노부의 걸음으로는 달포도 안 걸려!

findings.current:
Despite the casual tone of the answer, his face darkened.

He had let his emotions take hold of him and failed to notice the other’s presence.
findings.defect: The draft presents Mukyung’s inference as an established fact, dropping the source’s explicit indication that this is what he thought had happened.
findings.rationale: 생각했기 때문이었다 preserves Mukyung’s subjective interpretation rather than confirming why he missed Taekyung’s presence.
findings.replacement:
Despite the casual tone of the answer, his face darkened.

He thought he had let his emotions take hold of him and failed to notice the other’s presence.
findings.source:
대수롭지 않다는 듯 들려온 대답과는 달리 그의 얼굴은 어두워졌다.

감정에 사로잡혀 기척을 놓쳤다고 생각했기 때문이었다.

findings.current: In the past, he would have immediately rushed out of the training hall, smashed his head against the ground, and begged the Fire King to teach him even a single move.
findings.defect: “Smashed his head against the ground” reads as violent self-injury rather than the deeply deferential prostration described by 머리를 찧으며.
findings.rationale: The action expresses extreme supplication and hierarchy; it is not an attempt to injure himself.
findings.replacement: In the past, he would have immediately rushed out of the training hall, bowed until his forehead touched the ground, and begged the Fire King to teach him even a single move.
findings.source: 과거였다면 당장 수련동을 뛰쳐나가 머리를 찧으며 한 수 가르침을 청했을 것이다.

findings.current:
“A send-off? Don’t expect the impossible.”

“What if I did?”
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subjects of both lines. Taekyung says that he knows better than to expect a send-off, after which Mukyung asks what Taekyung came for instead.
findings.rationale: 기대할 걸 해야지 refers to Taekyung managing his own expectations; 하면? then prompts him to state his actual purpose.
findings.replacement:
“A send-off? I know better than to expect one.”

“Then?”

findings.defect: “Almost respected him” says the respect did not quite arise, while the source says Taekyung actually felt a measure of respect.
findings.rationale: 존경심마저 들 정도다 explicitly states that the reaction went so far as to include respect.
findings.replacement: I even felt a little respect for him.
findings.source: 역시 멘탈갑. 내심 존경심마저 들 정도다.

findings.current: With the sound of bones shifting out of place, Chulwoo’s hand—twice the size of mine—crumpled as though it had been crushed beneath a press.
findings.defect: The size comparison applies to Chulwoo himself, not to his hand. The draft changes a description of his enormous physique into an implausible hand-size measurement.
findings.rationale: 내 두 배만 한 modifies 철우: Chulwoo is twice Taekyung’s size.
findings.replacement: With the sound of bones shifting out of place, the hand of Chulwoo, a man twice my size, crumpled as though it had been crushed beneath a press.
findings.source: 뼈 어긋나는 소리와 함께 내 두 배만 한 철우의 손이 압축 프레스에 눌린 것처럼 찌그러졌다.

findings.current: “Don’t mess with me. You know what I mean, right?”
findings.defect: The draft redirects the warning toward Taekyung. In context, Taekyung is warning Chulwoo not to make advances toward Lee Seowol.
findings.rationale: 집적거리다 here means to pester or make unwanted advances toward someone; the omitted object is Lee Seowol, over whom Chulwoo previously challenged Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “Don’t make a move on her. You know what I mean, right?”

findings.current: Watching him, Eunhyang, the youngest of the Three Plum Blossom Elites, clicked her tongue.
findings.defect: “Clicked her tongue” conventionally conveys annoyance or disapproval, whereas 혀를 내둘렀다 expresses astonishment at Taekyung’s strength.
findings.rationale: Her following remark that the world is vast confirms that she is amazed, not expressing disapproval.
findings.replacement: Watching him, Eunhyang, the youngest of the Three Plum Blossom Elites, could only marvel.
findings.source: 그 광경에 매화삼절의 막내, 은향이 혀를 내둘렀다.

summary: The draft contains several actionable fidelity errors, including a changed travel time, reversed dialogue subjects, a misassigned size comparison, and a threat directed at the wrong person.
